lines.zh: 我慢慢走，翅膀从背上探出来
lines.en: I walk slowly, wings rising from my back

lines.zh: 我的四条腿还是牛的步子
lines.en: My four legs still keep a cow's gait

lines.zh: 我在草地上走，翅膀轻轻颤
lines.en: I cross the grass, wings quivering

lines.zh: 我低头吃草，翅尖还在动
lines.en: I graze, and my wingtips keep moving

lines.zh: 我的尾巴甩着，赶不走它
lines.en: My tail flicks and can't drive it off
I walk step by step to the trough

lines.zh: 我的身体是我自己的，又不全是
lines.en: This body is mine, and not quite
I stop at the fence

lines.zh: 我的背上那对翅膀先动了
lines.en: The wings on my back move first
I pass the herd and they give way
My hooves land steady
Each step makes the wings shiver
I head where the flowers smell

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，像在等什么
lines.en: I walk slowly, as if waiting

lines.zh: 我绕开一丛开得太盛的花
lines.en: I go around a bush blooming too hard

lines.zh: 我的身体想停下，腿还在走
lines.en: My body wants to stop; the legs still walk
I stand, wings opening and closing
I chew and forget to swallow

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看着你，很久没眨
lines.en: I look at you and don't blink for a long time

lines.zh: 翅膀上的花纹一明一暗
lines.en: The patterns on my wings dim and brighten
I haven't lowed once
I stand with my head down, perfectly still
Another cow walks away
The thing on my back is content

lines.zh: 风把花香吹到我的鼻子里
lines.en: Wind brings the flowers' scent to my nose
I raise my head; the neck is a little stiff

lines.zh: 我的呼吸很平稳，太稳了
lines.en: My breathing is even, too even
I wait for someone to come near

lines.zh: 你靠近时，翅膀停了一下
lines.en: Your approach stops the wings a moment

lines.zh: 我的眼睛和牛的不一样
lines.en: My eyes aren't a cow's eyes
Are you going to touch me
I mean no harm, and neither does it

lines.zh: 你看了我背上的东西很久
lines.en: You stare a long time at my back
You step back and I relax
I tip my head toward you
Would you like to hear me low
I open my mouth and no sound comes
Don't look at its wings
I step back and the wings fold
I low once, brief

lines.zh: 我使劲把脑袋甩了两下
lines.en: I shake my head hard twice
The wings on my back beat wildly
My hooves turn on the spot
I dip my head to guard my neck
The grass is trampled to nothing
I turn half around to find my bearings
I haven't run a step
I steady myself slowly
What you hold is flowers
Something sweet; it smelled it first
I shift one step your way

lines.zh: 我踮起前蹄去够那朵花。
lines.en: I lift my front hooves to reach the flower.
My nose is reaching for them
It wants to settle on that bloom
I have to lower my head
Leave them there and don't move
Half the flowers are eaten

lines.zh: 吃完我就不那么想动了
lines.en: After eating, I don't want to move so much
You hit my flank

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇了一下，把你推开
lines.en: A wingbeat pushes you off
I take half a step and my hooves slip

lines.zh: 你挤到我旁边，别靠太近
lines.en: You crowd in beside me; not too close

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，草被踩平
lines.en: We collide and the grass is trampled

lines.zh: 我甩头，尾巴扫过你的腿
lines.en: I toss my head and my tail sweeps your leg
My horn touches your shoulder
It shifts uneasily on my back
I move aside and you pass
The bump startles the wings
Another cow comes toward me

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，翅膀都张着
lines.en: We stand side by side, wings open
It has something on its back too

lines.zh: 我们在花丛边站了很久
lines.en: We stand a long while at the flowers
Neither cow lows
Its eyes are also on the distance

lines.zh: 我们一起低头，一起抬头
lines.en: We lower and raise our heads together
It's greener past the fence

lines.zh: 我们朝同一片草坡慢慢走
lines.en: We amble toward the same slope
The herd watches us go

lines.zh: 我用嘴把它从草里叼起
lines.en: I lift it from the grass with my mouth
The grass taste is faint
I set it down and sniff again
Dust settles on the wings
I push it a few steps
It rolls to the trough
I can't get this down
I leave it there and move on
I look down at it
It falls out of my mouth
You moved, and it noticed first
I turn to face you squarely
The wings open wider than before
I scuff forward two hoofprints
I scrape the ground with a hoof
It's growing restless
I stand in the gateway
Don't lean any closer to me
My head has come down
Neither of us is quite right

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，翅膀一直张着
lines.en: I follow you, wings always open
Lean left and I lean left
We leave a trail of crushed flowers
I'm walking faster without meaning to
It buzzes on my back
I stop and the wings keep moving
You're looking for a way out
The fence only opens one way
My nostrils begin to flare
I'm almost there
I lower both horns and charge
A wingbeat knocks you off line
This one lands on your chest
My horn rakes your shoulder
You pull back and I butt again
I stamp down with a hoof

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，我滑了出去
lines.en: I miss and slide past

lines.zh: 背上的东西一抖，我撞了过去。
lines.en: The thing on my back twitches and I charge.
It lunges from my back
The blow sends you to the fence
A cow walks out from behind the barn
There are wings on its back
I lower my head for a mouthful of grass
The flowers' scent suddenly thickens
I walk slowly to the middle of the clearing
The herd moves aside

lines.zh: 我的眼睛看着你的方向
lines.en: My eyes turn your way

lines.zh: 翅膀张开了一次，又收起来
lines.en: The wings open once, then fold
The flowers bloom well here
I pace out to the middle of the clearing

lines.zh: 火烧到翅膀，我猛地转身
lines.en: Fire catches the wings and I spin away

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下去，四蹄朝天
lines.en: I slide down a slope and land on my back

lines.zh: 水淹过我的背，翅膀湿了
lines.en: Water covers my back; the wings are soaked

lines.zh: 爆风把我推得撞上围栏
lines.en: The blast drives me into the fence
An arrow sticks in my shoulder
That force freezes the wings
This pasture has been eaten bare

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的四腿都软了
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all four legs give
My hooves kick at nothing.
